editorial.blurb: Lao Sze Chuan brings authentic Sichuan cuisine to the Northern Suburbs with spectacularly flavored dishes and a modern, warm atmosphere.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit during quieter weekday hours for a more relaxed experience—weekends get lively and loud, and arrive hungry since portions are generous enough for two to share.

topDishes.note: Perfectly fried, salty but balanced—a dish reviewers never skip
Not greasy with lots of fresh veggies, spot-on texture
Spiced and salty with a unique Chinese take on cured meat
